name: Mystic Report ~Koi no Bukatsu wa Chikoku Shinai~
original_name: ミスティック・リポート ～恋の部活はチコクしない～
source:
Main character belongs to school newspaper club. He is inspired by the the seven school wonders stories and takes interview from girls who experience strange phenomena at school. With his pretty girl assistant he faces mystic, but so real dangers.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公属于校报社。他受学校七大不可思议故事启发，采访经历校园怪异现象的女孩。与漂亮助手一起，他面对神秘却真实的危险。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
